usedFor: Kommo holds the customer conversations and Google Contacts keeps your address book, so “New Contact” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Kommo, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Each new Kommo contact is saved to Google Contacts, so the address book stays current.

watchOut: Adding “New Contact Is Added” in Google Contacts as well can loop, copying the same person back.
